acf.speaker_position: IT Manager, Founder of The Female Enterprise brand

blocks.html: IT Service Management & SAP expert, IT leader . Founder of The Female Enterprise brand, whose mission is to support women in building self-confidence. MBA graduate. Trainer, mentor, and conference speaker. Finalist of WomenTech Network Rising Star in STEM of the Year Award 2020. Member of the Expertki Razem Association, #KobietaKrakowa Inspiring Girls Poland Role Model
